name: Murmuration
desc: A Reynolds boids flock of hundreds of starlings that swirls, splits and reforms across a graded dusk sky, its speed painted as hue while motion-blur ribbons trail behind — switchable to additive neon vectors, a thermal density heat-map, a blueprint vector schematic, or dry sumi-ink silhouettes.

energy.doc: streak brightness / length / force gain (obvious at max)

density.doc: flock size — agent count 180..620 (crowd at max)

scale.doc: neighbor radius + bird size (big = one giant flock)
